description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseEntity' for the application core entities in the eShopOnWeb project. It provides a common Id property for entities derived from it, simplifying entity identification.

classes.name: BaseEntity
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for entity classes, providing a unique identifier property.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Virtual property for entity identifier, can be overridden in derived classes.
